template_data.headline_html: Five pricing errors that follow you for years.

items.title: Wrong Basis of Award anchor
items.sub: Your GSA rate ties to your best commercial deal — misalign it and the CO finds it.

items.title: Pricing too low to win
items.sub: GSA rate = your ceiling on every task order. Set it right from day one.

items.title: Ignoring Price Reductions Clause
items.sub: Discount a commercial client below GSA? You owe that same reduction to federal buyers.

items.title: Skipping economic price adjustments
items.sub: CPI increases are allowed annually. You must file the mod to capture them.

items.title: Underloading indirect costs
items.sub: Overhead and G&A are real costs. Miss them in your rates and your margin disappears.
